{"user_id": "external-reader", "query": "Jacksonville began to suffer and decline after what major world event?", "memories": [], "documents": [{"id": "squad-p-96357c5125cc29ec", "text": "Jacksonville, like most large cities in the United States, suffered from negative effects of rapid urban sprawl after World War II. Though no battles were fought in Jacksonville proper, the city changed hands several times between Union and Confederate forces. The Skirmish of the Brick Church in 1862 just outside Jacksonville proper resulted in the first Confederate victory in Florida.
